sehemu: Part V: Court of Appeal of the United Republic
maudhui: A Justice of Appeal shall not assume the functions of his office until he has taken and subscribed the oath of allegiance and any other oath relating to the proper discharge of his office which may be prescribed by a law enacted by Parliament.
